combat_history.event: Fielded and prominently exercised by PLA Army units, including opposite Taiwan.
combat_history.significance: Signalled a land-based long-range precision-fires threat to the strait.

modernization.description: Expanding guided-rocket and tactical-missile options and networked targeting.
modernization.impact: Broadens the range and precision of land-based fires.

vulnerabilities.description: Long-range precision needs off-board ISR and cueing.
High-value launchers are counter-fire and air-strike targets.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Land-based long-range precision fires against airfields, ports and command nodes, including across the Taiwan Strait.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: PLA Army long-range fire units networked with ISR; complements the PLARF DF-series.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: HIMARS/PrSM is the U.S. guided long-range fires system; the PHL-191 fires longer-range rockets and larger tactical missiles.
The Pinaka is shorter-ranged area/precision rocket artillery; the PHL-191 reaches far further.
The DF-series provides the long-range ballistic tier; the PHL-191 densifies the cheaper, numerous lower tier.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: The layers of China's strike complex.

doctrine.role: Long-range modular guided rocket/tactical-missile launcher for land-based precision fires.
doctrine.employment: Fires 370 mm guided rockets or larger tactical ballistic missiles on networked cueing across a contested theatre.
doctrine.design_philosophy: Blur rocket and missile fires into cheap, numerous, long-range precision land strike.
doctrine.threat_context: Lets PLA land units strike across the Taiwan Strait, densifying the A2/AD complex below the DF-series.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read against the US HIMARS/PrSM, India's Pinaka and China's own DF-21D.
